shadow.use: ledge-jump shadow. One 8x8 tile drawn as a 16x16 block: TL normal (OBP1), TR x-flip, BL y-flip, BR x+y-flip, at screen (64, 68) i.e. 8 px below the player sprite top, while BIT_LEDGE_OR_FISHING is set.

smoke.use: boulder dust puff (Strength) and S.S. Anne departure smoke; loaded 4x as a 16x16 block

spinners.use: 4 spinner-arrow tiles (SpinnerArrowAnimTiles) swapped into the tileset while the player is being moved by an arrow tile (FACILITY/GYM; see tileset spinnerArrows)

healMachine.use: Pokemon Center healing machine: flashing monitor + heal ball sprites (2 tiles)

battleTransition.use: solid black tile used by battle transitions

emote_shock.use: emotion bubble (shock); 16x16, drawn 16 px above the sprite (screen y = sprite y - 16, same x) for 60 frames, OBP0

emote_question.use: emotion bubble (question); 16x16, drawn 16 px above the sprite (screen y = sprite y - 16, same x) for 60 frames, OBP0

emote_happy.use: emotion bubble (happy); 16x16, drawn 16 px above the sprite (screen y = sprite y - 16, same x) for 60 frames, OBP0

cutLeaf.use: cutting tall grass: 4 copies (attrs alternate x-flip / y-flip, OBP1)

ledgeJump.note: one entry per overworld loop iteration (2 frames) while jumping; the player moves 2 steps (16 px each) in the jump direction

tallGrass: No overlay graphic: when the tile under a sprite (bottom-left tile of its cell) equals the tileset grassTile, the sprite's lower 8 px rows get OAM priority (BG colours 1-3 draw over them).
doors: Gen 1 has no door animation graphics: warps fade the palette (GBFadeOutToBlack) and, when arriving on a door tile, the player auto-steps down one cell.
